description: Thin wrapper around the token autocomplete popup used to insert document tokens. Forwards visibility, the token list, query, highlighted index, and loading state, with token creation disabled.

parameters.name: IsVisible
parameters.description: Whether the token menu is visible.

parameters.name: OnHighlightedIndexChanged
parameters.description: Raised when a token is selected.

parameters.name: OnTokenSelected
parameters.description: Whether the token provider is loading.

parameters.name: Tokens
parameters.description: Whether the token menu is visible.
